from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as E
ns={'s':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
for p in sorted(Path('docs/liitteet').glob('*.xlsx')):
 print('\\nFILE',p)
 with ZipFile(p) as z:
  strings=[]
  if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
   strings=[''.join(e.itertext()) for e in E.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml')).findall('s:si',ns)]
  for name in z.namelist():
   if name.startswith('xl/worksheets/sheet') and name.endswith('.xml'):
    print(name)
    root=E.fromstring(z.read(name))
    for row in root.findall('.//s:row',ns):
     cells=[]
     for c in row.findall('s:c',ns):
      typ=c.get('t'); v=c.find('s:v',ns)
      val=v.text if v is not None else ''.join(c.find('s:is',ns).itertext()) if c.find('s:is',ns) is not None else ''
      if typ=='s':val=strings[int(val)]
      cells.append(c.get('r')+'='+val)
     print(' | '.join(cells))
PY"
